reuse.why: Routes getScheduledAmount through the new getWorstCaseAmount, but the five server/shared sites keep their own missing/number/range dispatch instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount, which already decides all three cases.

duplication.why: The range arithmetic is now single-sourced, but the diff leaves five copies of the null/number/range ternary in place around the new helper rather than collapsing them into getScheduledAmount.

placement.why: The new rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where amount resolution for schedules belongs.

scope.why: Only the midpoint sites, their comments, a focused test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Changing the range rule again needs one edit, though the parallel getScheduledAmount and per-site dispatches remain two ways to resolve the same amount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts createScheduleList, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, and shared computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keep their own dispatch and call getWorstCaseAmount instead of the existing getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No new copies; the remaining per-site ternaries are pre-existing and left as they were.

one_place.where: getWorstCaseAmount in shared/schedules.ts is the single definition of the range rule, used by getScheduledAmount and by every server/shared site that previously computed the midpoint.
